newsitem.title: GERMANY: Koebnick says Bundesbank has no dollar target.
newsitem.headline: Koebnick says Bundesbank has no dollar target.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Hans-Juergen Koebnick said on Wednesday he believed current dollar developments were part of a normalisation process.
He also said that the German central bank has no target for the dollar.
"I would view these developments still as part of a normalisation process," Koebnick told Reuters about the current strength of the dollar.
Koebnick added that it was primarily the responsibility of financial markets to assess the proper level of the dollar.
"As you know, we have no dollar target," he said.
Koebnick, who spoke while attending a conference on monetary union, also said the dollar's level was "neutral".
